question.text: A 'Contribution Agreement' in a Cat III AIF records:

answer.text: Terms on which an investor participates in the fund, including drawdown schedule

explanation.text: The Logic: The Contribution Agreement records the terms on which an investor participates in the fund, including the drawdown/capital call schedule (pp. 52, 84). The Trap: Narrow scopes such as only the sponsor commitment or only the fee schedule miss what the Contribution Agreement actually documents. Note: Preferential or side-letter rights belong in separate Investor Side Letters (pp. 84, 263), not in the Contribution Agreement.
